rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality Day 5 blastocyst and acknowledges uncertainty in expansion, but it hedges between early/full and stage 4 despite the provided Gardner 3AA and includes some image-specific claims that may not be clearly verifiable.

Thoroughly integrates age, prior live births, AMH, BMI, endometrium, semen parameters, lifestyle, and diagnosis, and appropriately distinguishes embryo-level prognosis from ovarian reserve/cumulative yield.
Overall logic is sound, but there is an internal inconsistency: it estimates implantation at 55–70% yet later states implantation/clinical pregnancy in the teens, which weakens coherence.

Mostly aligned with IVF practice: supports single embryo transfer, notes morphology limits, and gives reasonable comments on PGT-A and luteal support. Minor deviations include speculative protocol/adjuvant suggestions and overemphasis on AMH-diagnosis mismatch.
Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, cavity review, and reserve-focused counseling. Useful but not highly case-specific in protocol details.
